'''2014 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Ganden Yanaga DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ganden Yanaga]] at [[2014 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Invasion / In Complete Control]]
* '''Username:''' Cam Solusar
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
